definitions.gloss: bonesetting clinic; osteopathic clinic; chiropractic-style clinic
definitions.explanation: A clinic run by a licensed judo therapist (柔道整復師) that treats bone fractures, dislocations, sprains, and muscle injuries through manual therapy. Very common in Japan and covered by health insurance for certain treatments.

examples.japanese: ⟦{腰|こし}→腰：02210_koshi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で{整骨院|せいこついん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧きた。
examples.english: My lower back hurt, so I went to an osteopathic clinic.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{整骨院|せいこついん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦オープン→オープン：10831_oopun⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A new bonesetting clinic opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦スポーツ→スポーツ：04740_supootsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{怪我|けが}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦したら→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧{整骨院|せいこついん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: When people get injured playing sports, many go not only to the hospital but also to a bonesetting clinic.

notes:
USAGE:
{整骨院|せいこついん} is also called ⟦{接骨院|せっこついん}→接骨院：20981_sekkotsuin⟧. Both refer to the same type of clinic. They are distinct from ⟦{整体院|せいたいいん}→整体院：25767_seitaiin⟧ (bodywork/chiropractic clinic), which is not covered by health insurance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整骨院|せいこついん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}う→通う：01217_kayou⟧ (to go regularly to a bonesetting clinic)
- {整骨院|せいこついん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive treatment at a bonesetting clinic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{接骨院|せっこついん}→接骨院：20981_sekkotsuin⟧: same meaning, alternative name
- ⟦{整体院|せいたいいん}→整体院：25767_seitaiin⟧: bodywork/chiropractic clinic — not insurance-covered, different qualifications
- {鍼灸院|しんきゅういん}: acupuncture and moxibustion clinic
